author: Riilo
body:
Name: Infinity
Creators: Riilo
Contributors: KomodoLord1, Seqn_, zehlk,
Images: http://imgur.com/a/RCkrp
XML:
Download: (will give when all feedback has been completed)
General Information:
 - Yellow vs. Purple
 - 20v20
 - Lime and Dark Green wool (actually separated)
- Pink and Purple Wool (actually separated)
Important: This map may be confusing but I am going to explain it to you before you comment these things. I have been told that this map is huge, which I agree with. When players come out of spawn they will have Speed 2 for five seconds only. If they wish to make iron armour then that will take up their speed 2 time. Speed 2 will get them between the frontlines and the wool lane entrance. As you can see from the photos, the wool room looks connected but it is actually separated. Another thing is that the lanes have parts where they are really close. This has barriers to stop people double capping very easily. To double cap, they will have to jump off the lane onto the first layer and go up the other entrance if that makes sense. If anyone needs me to show them and explain it more, I am willing to do so. Also, this map does not have TNT. 

Feedback is appreciated!

replies.author: dev_revs
replies.body: The problem with avicus DTC is the void areas are too small to each side, its a cannon map not a bridge to the other side. The map is overall to big and wouldn't play well in DTC in my opinion. It's a great design, just I don't think it would work with the current layout of the map for DTC.
